Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Would it be possible to extend it to more (like 200)?
60 characters is too short in many cases and leads to truncated titles, especially:
- in tournament announcements where you must specify the location, date, tournament name in the title
- card ideas where tags such as "Submission" already takes 1/6 of the title, and doesn't leave much space to add tags (such as : Tzimisce master crypt acceleration)

I've already done it on the French forum and haven't seen any abuse.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
